place.name: Tansyhook Crossing
place.description: A busy meeting of two public orchard lanes at a narrow timber bridge over an irrigation channel. A roofed weighing shed and fruit-cart layby stand beside the lane; the canal road continues downhill past hedge-grown orchards.
place.culture: Orchard Vales in the Asterwyn Crown: family orchards, seasonal harvest work, draft-beast caravans and barges use the adjoining country roads.

recap:
CAMPAIGN: Maddoc Maddren (seed 3951775931)
SCENE: At Thistlebell Yard, Maddoc rebuked the arguing handlers, then approached the burden beast's twisted left-shoulder harness. Moving carefully, he freed the pinching strap and straightened it without removing the full harness. The beast held steady, flicked an ear and shifted weight more comfortably. The two handlers are now watching; the beast has not yet resumed hauling.
